title: 181. Algebra, Equations & Inequalities: Solving Multi-Step Linear Equations
description: A comprehensive mathematics curriculum progressing from foundational numeracy and core mathematical concepts to algebra, geometry, calculus, linear algebra, probability, statistics, discrete mathematics, optimization, mathematical foundations of AI, advanced pure mathematics, and emerging research methods.

questions.learningObjective: Solve a linear equation that requires two inverse operations.
questions.question: Solve \(2x+5=13\).
questions.explanation:
Subtract \(5\) from both sides, then divide both sides by \(2\):
\[
\begin{aligned}
2x+5-5 &= 13-5\\
2x &= 8\\
x &= 4
\end{aligned}
\]
Therefore, the solution is \(x=4\).
questions.hint: Undo addition or subtraction first, then undo multiplication or division.

questions.concept: Solving Two-Step Linear Equations with Subtraction
questions.learningObjective: Solve a two-step linear equation involving subtraction.
questions.question: Solve \(3x-7=8\).
questions.explanation:
Add \(7\) to both sides, then divide both sides by \(3\):
\[
\begin{aligned}
3x-7+7 &= 8+7\\
3x &= 15\\
x &= 5
\end{aligned}
\]
Therefore, the solution is \(x=5\).
questions.hint: Add the opposite of the constant term to both sides.

questions.concept: Solving Simple Equations with Variables on Both Sides
questions.learningObjective: Solve a linear equation with variable terms on both sides by collecting like terms.
questions.question: Solve \(5x+2=3x+10\).
questions.explanation:
Subtract \(3x\) from both sides, subtract \(2\) from both sides, then divide by \(2\):
\[
\begin{aligned}
5x+2-3x &= 3x+10-3x\\
2x+2 &= 10\\
2x &= 8\\
x &= 4
\end{aligned}
\]
Therefore, the solution is \(x=4\).
questions.hint: Collect the variable terms on one side and the constant terms on the other.

questions.learningObjective: Solve a multi-step linear equation by applying the distributive property.
questions.question: Solve \(4(x-2)=20\).
questions.explanation:
Distribute \(4\), add \(8\) to both sides, then divide by \(4\):
\[
\begin{aligned}
4x-8 &= 20\\
4x &= 28\\
x &= 7
\end{aligned}
\]
Therefore, the solution is \(x=7\).
questions.hint: Distribute first, then isolate the variable.

questions.concept: Solving Equations with Distribution and Addition
questions.learningObjective: Solve a linear equation involving distribution and combining constants.
questions.question: Solve \(2(x+3)-4=10\).
questions.explanation:
Distribute \(2\), combine like terms, subtract \(2\), then divide by \(2\):
\[
\begin{aligned}
2x+6-4 &= 10\\
2x+2 &= 10\\
2x &= 8\\
x &= 4
\end{aligned}
\]
Therefore, the solution is \(x=4\).
questions.hint: Simplify the left side before isolating the variable.

questions.concept: Solving Equations with Variables on Both Sides
questions.learningObjective: Solve a multi-step linear equation with variable terms on both sides.
questions.question: Solve \(7x-3=4x+12\).
questions.explanation:
Subtract \(4x\) from both sides, add \(3\), then divide by \(3\):
\[
\begin{aligned}
7x-3-4x &= 4x+12-4x\\
3x-3 &= 12\\
3x &= 15\\
x &= 5
\end{aligned}
\]
Therefore, the solution is \(x=5\).
questions.hint: Collect all variable terms on one side.

questions.concept: Solving Equations with Variables on Both Sides and Negative Solutions
questions.learningObjective: Solve a linear equation with variables on both sides that has a negative solution.
questions.question: Solve \(3x+5=2x-4\).
questions.explanation:
Subtract \(2x\) from both sides, then subtract \(5\):
\[
\begin{aligned}
3x+5-2x &= 2x-4-2x\\
x+5 &= -4\\
x &= -9
\end{aligned}
\]
Therefore, the solution is \(x=-9\).
questions.hint: Move variable terms to one side and constants to the other.

questions.concept: Solving Equations with Distribution and Variables on Both Sides
questions.learningObjective: Solve a multi-step linear equation involving distribution and variable terms on both sides.
questions.question: Solve \(5(x-1)=3x+7\).
questions.explanation:
Distribute \(5\), subtract \(3x\), add \(5\), then divide by \(2\):
\[
\begin{aligned}
5x-5 &= 3x+7\\
2x-5 &= 7\\
2x &= 12\\
x &= 6
\end{aligned}
\]
Therefore, the solution is \(x=6\).
questions.hint: Distribute first, then collect variable terms on one side.

questions.concept: Solving Equations with Distribution on One Side and Variables on Both Sides
questions.learningObjective: Solve a linear equation with distribution and variables on both sides.
questions.question: Solve \(2(3x-4)=5x+2\).
questions.explanation:
Distribute \(2\), subtract \(5x\), then add \(8\):
\[
\begin{aligned}
6x-8 &= 5x+2\\
x-8 &= 2\\
x &= 10
\end{aligned}
\]
Therefore, the solution is \(x=10\).
questions.hint: Distribute, then isolate \(x\) by subtracting the smaller variable term.

questions.concept: Solving Equations with Distribution and a Negative Coefficient
questions.learningObjective: Solve a multi-step linear equation involving distribution and a negative variable coefficient.
questions.question: Solve \(4x-3(2x-5)=1\).
questions.explanation:
Distribute \(-3\), combine like terms, subtract \(15\), then divide by \(-2\):
\[
\begin{aligned}
4x-6x+15 &= 1\\
-2x+15 &= 1\\
-2x &= -14\\
x &= 7
\end{aligned}
\]
Therefore, the solution is \(x=7\).
questions.hint: Distribute the negative sign carefully before combining like terms.
